Chafetz Chaim source text - attribution and license
===================================================

The Chafetz Chaim passages used by this extension (the short source quotes in
the referral view, and every section reference and "open the source" link) are
taken from Sefaria:

  Work:        Chafetz Chaim - Part One, Hilchot Issurei Lashon Hara
               (principles 1-10), and Part Two, Hilchot Issurei Rechilut
               (principles 1-9)
  Taken from:  Sefaria - https://www.sefaria.org/Chafetz_Chaim
               (fetched through the Sefaria API, https://www.sefaria.org/api/texts/)
  Version:     "Chofetz Chaim" (Hebrew)
  Its source:  Hebrew Wikisource (as stated by Sefaria for this version)
               https://he.wikisource.org/wiki/%D7%97%D7%A4%D7%A5_%D7%97%D7%99%D7%99%D7%9D
  License:     CC BY-SA (Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike), as stated
               by Sefaria for this version.
               https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

Changes: the extension shows short excerpts only. The summaries, questions,
uncertainty notes and rule cards are this project's own draft wording based on
the text; they are not part of the source, are not a halachic ruling, and have
not been reviewed by a qualified authority.

ShareAlike: these source-derived data (section quotes, summaries, questions,
uncertainty notes and rule/referral cards) are distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0
(https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/) with the attribution above.
That license covers this text-derived data only, not the extension's code.

The full source layer (raw API responses, per-section refs, URLs and hashes) is
in the project repository: https://github.com/yonicc/lashon-hara-guard
(sources/chafetz-chaim/).

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

מקור טקסט החפץ חיים - קרדיט ורישיון

קטעי החפץ חיים שבתוסף (ציטוטי המקור הקצרים, מראי המקום וקישורי "פתח את המקור")
נלקחו מספריא (Sefaria), https://www.sefaria.org/Chafetz_Chaim , מהדורת
"Chofetz Chaim" בעברית, שמקורה לפי ספריא בוויקיטקסט העברי
(https://he.wikisource.org/wiki/חפץ_חיים), ברישיון CC BY-SA
(ייחוס-שיתוף זהה). התקצירים, השאלות וכרטיסי הכללים הם ניסוח טיוטה של הפרויקט
ואינם חלק מהמקור ואינם פסק הלכה.
